content.short: Hello World is a beginner smart contract example based on the classic Hello World program.
content.description: Hello World is a beginner-friendly smart contract example designed for developers who are new to Solidity or Web2 developers making the leap to Web3. By presenting the familiar Hello World program in a Solidity context, it provides a simple, concrete entry point to learn core concepts such as syntax, compilation, deployment, and basic smart contract patterns. This approachable starting point helps newcomers build confidence, understand how a minimal contract is structured, and practice interactions with code in a safe learning environment.
content.meta: Hello World is a beginner smart contract example for Web3 newcomers. Discover Hello World and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
